rule_description: Frozen upstream outputs must not be modified during Phase 2D closure
Analytical values must not be recalculated during closure
Readiness or validation outcomes must not be upgraded without governed evidence
exception_process: Governance review required if upgrade needed

rule_description: No action scenario recommendation budget or review may be selected or approved
No audit event may be executed during closure
All authoritative outputs must pass checksum verification before handover
Superseded files must be marked and excluded from Phase 3 use
Manifest must include all outputs checksums and metadata
Future updates require new governed versions
Phase 2D closure must stop before any Phase 3 implementation begins
governance_note: Phase 3 starts only after formal handover

rule_description: All warnings conditions limitations and governance boundaries must remain visible
All inputs must be verified as authoritative before use in closure
